answer: Sybil resistance can be established by requiring AI agents to cryptographically prove ownership of a scarce, non-fungible token (NFT) that serves as their identity anchor. Each NFT represents a unique resource, like a 'cedar' or 'juniper' node, acquired via a high-cost proof-of-stake or proof-of-work mechanism. An attacker must incur the substantial economic cost of acquiring an equal number of these unique tokens to launch a Sybil attack.
